senses.example: Desayuno café con leche y tostada.
senses.exampleGloss: I have coffee with milk and toast for breakfast.

alternatives.reason: Fuller phrase, more formal/LatAm in feel; desayunar alone is the Peninsular norm.
Midday meal in Spain; in parts of LatAm it means a late breakfast, so the sense differs.
The main midday meal in Spain; a different meal slot.

notes: Meal times differ between Spain and LatAm; the examples keep the Peninsular schedule.
